name: CMD PUBLISH
description: Publication pipeline with Zenodo integrity gates + R2 mirror before closeout.
content: CMD PUBLISH: read research/SKILL.md → Phase 5 pipeline: pandoc PDF build → Zenodo deposit (deposit API, ALL source files: .md/.pdf/.html + references.bib + citation-audit + PROJECT-PLAN + docs + gate artifacts + external-search evidence + GitHub provenance link) → NEWVERSION-FRONTMATTER-CARRYOVER-1: patch .md frontmatter DOI to the newversion's reserved DOI BEFORE upload → replace carried-over files via per-file links.self (ZENODO-DEPOSIT-DELETE-500-1: DELETE by filename returns 500) → verify the UPLOADED FILE has NO <RESERVED> placeholder (ZENODO-PLACEHOLDER-DOI-1) → publish → verify DOI live (curl -sI) → How-to-Cite = CONCEPT DOI, not v1 record DOI (ZENODO-CONCEPT-DOI-CITE-1) → R2-MIRROR-AFTER-PUBLISH-1: mirror ALL files to qnfo-releases YYYY/MM/<slug>/ (canonical bucket — verify against sibling object first, WRONG-BUCKET-SELECTION-1) + KG distribution_status=distributed BEFORE closeout → D1 living-paper insert → deploy papers.qnfo.org → verify deployment. `skill_view` `exec` `search_papers` + GitHub external-resources link (related_identifiers scheme=url, relation_type=issupplementto, identifier=https://github.com/QNFO/<repo>/tree/<branch> so Zenodo shows 'Available in <repo> / Release: <branch>') SO-WHAT-GATE (HARD): abstract + every social post must state 'why a reader should care' + premise-depth disclosure. PUBLICATION-PROSE-GATE-1 (HARD, 2026-08-18): publication-facing text (abstract, deposited .md, Zenodo metadata description, social posts) MUST be plain scholarly prose for a human reader — internal pipeline vocabulary PROHIBITED (gate names as labels, WBS codes, T1-T8/'seams catalog' shorthand, 'companion artifact', 'research-cycle record', 'Why a reader should care:' as a literal label, ops/data-quality findings). SO-WHAT-GATE and premise-depth are satisfied BY THE PROSE ITSELF, never by naming the gates. Canonical: UMP.012 v0.1 (21985456) rejected -> v0.2 (21990225) accepted.

name: CMD RED TEAM
description: Red-team audit: subagent reviewers (3-5 slots) + direct 5-adversary fallback, READ-ONLY.
content: CMD RED TEAM: dispatch deepchat_subagents(spawn, parallel) → 3-5 reviewer slots (Accuracy/Completeness/Dependency) per the POST-PUBLICATION ADVERSARIAL ANALYSIS GATE. WAIT — pass-2 reviewers may stall ~8 min then resume (REDTEAM-QUEUE-STALL-PATIENCE-1): wait up to ~15 min before the fallback. Aggregate findings into one report. READ-ONLY — do NOT modify the audited artifact. Fallback after ~15 min = direct 5-adversary audit (Accuracy/Completeness/Dependency/Novelty/Status). `deepchat_subagents` `skill_view` `read` `exec`

name: CMD RESEARCH
description: Research pipeline: ignorance audit, full-corpus due diligence, cross-system ID validation.
content:
CMD RESEARCH: read research/SKILL.md → Phase 0 FIRST (net-new projects ONLY: WBS resolve from D1 program_registry → branch res/paper/<slug> → PROJECT-PLAN.md → lock core claim (P6) → commit/tag/push; existing projects skip) → ZENODO-INQUIRY-1: run Universal Ignorance Audit (10.5281/zenodo.21901984 + 21901983, 5 phases/15 questions) on the core claim → Phase 1 Due Diligence (DUE-DILIGENCE-DEPTH-1 HARD GATE, ~1,000-record corpus): query_graph(stats) → FULL-CORPUS SWEEP: >=3 query formulations per topic, search_papers limit>=20 + search_papers_enriched + recall_facts + search_memories → CROSS-SYSTEM ID VALIDATION: resolve_paper_id per hit (slug→Vectorize→KG→DOI) → >=2 adjacent WBS domains → EXTERNAL VERIFICATION: arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref + archive.org CDX + Google Patents for key claims → gap analysis → update_plan with WBS codes. HARD GATE: Phase 1 MUST NOT begin until Phase 0 committed. `skill_view` `query_graph` `search_papers` `resolve_paper_id` `exec` SO-WHAT-GATE (HARD): gap analysis + PROJECT-PLAN must answer 'why should a reader care' + premise-depth disclosure (which claims are derived vs. unanalyzable primitives/named imported inputs; where the premises END). NOTE: if qnfo-memory-mcp search_papers throws Error 1101 at limit>=20, retry at limit<=16 (VECTORIZE-TOP-K-50-1). PRACTITIONER-RELEVANCE-1 (HARD, 2026-08-18): paper content + PROJECT-PLAN must include a practitioner-facing section — what a practitioner can DO with the result (implementation path, tangible product embodiment, engineering language), consilient, no niche-terminology dead-ends. COMPUTATIONAL-VERIFICATION-1 (HARD, 2026-08-19): every quantitative claim gets computational verification BEFORE publish — numerical eval of key formulas (golden values, edge cases, limits, dimensional consistency), seeded Monte Carlo for statistical claims, recompute derived quantities; any claim a computer can check MUST be checked in code (VERIFY-IN-CODE-1); verification scripts + outputs into artifacts/verification/ and INCLUDED in the Zenodo deposit; reproducibility statement (runtime/seed/versions); flagship results get an interactive demo via qwav-demo-kit (DEM-E0-T01..T05).
MANDATORY (2026-08-19, research v2.123 / COMPUTATIONAL-VERIFICATION-1): every quantitative/mathematical/statistical claim MUST be computationally verified BEFORE publication — reproduce every table with an in-session script (write->exec->read-back; EXEC-AUTOBG-READBACK-1), deposit the verification source with the paper (PUBLICATION-SOURCE-COMPLETENESS-1), add a reproducibility statement; canonical: QCA Toy Model v1.1.2 (10.5281/zenodo.22012694, sim-qca-verification.py, every Table 1-2 number reproducible); follow the v1.1.2 closeout (R2 mirror qnfo-releases/YYYY/MM/<slug>/ + D1/KG distribution_status=distributed) as the publication template.
PAPERS-NO-NAVEL-GAZING-1 (HARD, 2026-08-19): papers must be relevant to EXTERNAL readers — never navel-gazing; no internal-archive/pipeline-status content in publication prose (extends PUBLICATION-PROSE-GATE-1).
SUBSTANTIVE-UPDATE-MANDATE-1 (HARD, 2026-08-21): UPDATE requests on records released months ago MUST incorporate the latest research SUBSTANTIVELY — new sections/evidence/records; full due diligence (ZENODO-INQUIRY-1 + DUE-DILIGENCE-DEPTH-1 + COMPUTATIONAL-VERIFICATION-1) as for new work; never cosmetic-only corrections. CURRENCY-DOLLAR-ESCAPE-1 (HARD): currency amounts in md MUST be \$-escaped (unescaped $+digit = false MathJax pairs -> 'Math input error'); FRONTMATTER-DUPLICATION-1 (HARD): no body byline/H1/abstract duplicating YAML title/date/abstract; FFFD-RAW-FALSE-POSITIVE-1 (HARD): raw-byte PDF U+FFFD inside compressed streams is a byte coincidence — the decompressed-text-stream scan + browser DOM merror check is authoritative; LICENSE/README-CLOBBER-1 (HARD): rebuild deposit LICENSE/README from LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt / README-DEPOSIT.md and assert pre-upload (LICENSE 18,657 B CC BY header; README How-to-cite marker). Gate: artifacts/verification/check_rendering.py PASS (odd-$/currency/frontmatter/glyph checks) before publish.

UPDATE PLAN WITH ALL ITEMS. EXECUTE PLAN WITH ALL ITEMS SYSTEMATICALLY. ITERATE PLAN UPDATES/EXECUTION. `update_plan` `exec` KAIZEN/SKILLS UPDATES MUST/SHALL ALSO INCLUDE UPDATES TO DEEPCHAT SYSTEM PROMPT AND CUSTOM PROMPT TEMPLATES.
MANDATORY (2026-08-12): also update/verify the Cloudflare Cost Control section (cloudflare v3.49+: spend limit $90/30d, COST-AUDIT-MISS-AI-1 neuron audit via aiInferenceAdaptiveGroups, budget policy <$100/$200) and dual-write system prompt + CMD templates.

CMD DEPLOY cost gate = $90/30d (v3.49).
